appliesTo: future PWS contracts introduced under pws-v1

compatibleChanges: add an optional field with a deterministic default
add documentation or translation without changing semantics
add a validator that accepts every previously valid pws-v1 payload
add a deprecated alias read adapter without enabling alias writes
backwardCompatibility.readRule: Previously valid pws-v1 payloads remain readable.
backwardCompatibility.writeRule: New writes use canonical pws-v1 fields only.

changes: remove or rename a canonical field
change a field type, meaning, identifier or owner module
remove an accepted pws-v1 read value or alias
change state transition, permission or authorisation semantics

requiredWhen: persisted data cannot be read correctly by the target schema
identifier, relationship, constraint or required field changes
a write-source ownership transfer affects stored data
notRequiredWhen: optional additive metadata with a deterministic default
rules: Migration is explicit, ordered, additive and checksum-verified.
Migration preserves identity, lineage, audit and rollback evidence.
Schema release and Migration execution are separate authorised actions.

schemaValidation.readMode: accept valid pws-v1 plus declared Legacy adapters
schemaValidation.failureMode: reject without persistence or side effect
